title: U.S. forces disable commercial ship that allegedly tried to breach Iran blockade
summary: A U.S. military aircraft struck a Palau-flagged ship with precision munitions after giving multiple warnings, U.S. Central Command said.

title: 2 American Airlines jets clip wings on tarmac of Reagan Airport
summary: There were no injuries when the wingtips of two American Airlines jets made contact Friday evening on the tarmac of Ronald Reagan Washington National Airport outside Washington, D.C.

title: Power being slowly restored as heavy Thanksgiving storm eases
summary: Heavy rain over flooded East Coast communities began easing Friday, and power was slowly restored to hundreds of thousands of customers.

title: U.S. Air Force cloud platform breached by hackers, report says
summary: The alleged incident follows a series of breaches and outages that have been reported at federal agencies this month.

title: Restless Ghosts: One Case, A Century of Doubt | Case by Case | "48 Hours" Podcast
summary: Nearly 100 years ago, two young socialites were found dead in a New Jersey mansion. Ruled a murder-suicide, the case sparked rumors of a cover-up, a controversial investigation, and questions that still linger today. CBS News correspondent Jim Axelrod talks with journalist and author Annie McCormick about the mystery that wouldn't stay buried.

title: 2 American Airlines jets clip their wings at Reagan National Airport
summary: Two American Airlines jets clipped their wings at Reagan National Airport outside Washington, D.C., after colliding.

title: Documentary clip reveals new details on Princess Kate's cancer journey
summary: A clip from the upcoming documentary "Heal" reveals new details about Princess Kate's cancer journey, which she has long kept private. Jericka Duncan has more.

title: How severe weather rocked this Thanksgiving, from power outages to flight delays
summary: Americans across the country faced disruptions from severe weather this Thanksgiving, including delayed flights, flooding and power outages. Lilia Luciano reports and Bill Kelly has the forecast.

title: Lawmakers ask Trump to rescind Putin's G20 invitation over alleged intelligence-sharing with Iran
summary: President Trump is facing renewed criticism over his friendship with Vladimir Putin, with a group of bipartisan lawmakers urging him to disinvite the Russian leader from next month's G20 summit in Florida. Weijia Jiang has more.

title: Pittsburgh Steelers take the field for first game since star quarterback Rodgers' release
summary: The Pittsburgh Steelers took the field Friday for their first game after star quarterback Aaron Rodgers was released following comments accusing coach Mike McCarthy of sleeping through meetings and more. Jason Allen has the story.

title: Shoppers expected to spend nearly $13 billion this Black Friday, Adobe says
summary: Shoppers are expected to spend nearly $13 billion on Black Friday alone, according to Adobe, as the holiday shopping rush kicks off. Tom Hanson has the story.

title: U.S. Air Force cloud platform breached by hackers, report says
summary: The U.S. Air Force's cloud platform was breached by hackers, possibly exposing sensitive military and personnel information, according to a Reuters report. The Air Force did not confirm or deny the breach. Nicole Sganga has more.

title: Woman surprises hospital valet who supported her through cancer treatment with Bills tickets
summary: Breast cancer survivor Kate Fink credits hospital valet Jon Avery with helping her fight the disease. She surprised the Buffalo Bills fan with tickets and field passes. Steve Hartman goes on the road.
